key_insight: CREW replaces fixed multi-agent RWG pipelines with a reinforcement-learned collaboration policy, letting LLM agents dynamically choose how to retrieve, share, compose, and critique content.
engineering_relevance: This offers a more adaptive and cost-efficient framework for automating related work writing in scientific document pipelines, especially where synthesis quality depends on flexible agent coordination.
method: Multi-agent LLM framework for Related Work Generation (RWG)
Agents autonomously select actions: Retrieve, Disseminate, Compose, Critique
Policy optimized with Independent Proximal Policy Optimization (IPPO)
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on a standard RWG benchmark, showing higher quality than strong baselines while also reducing token costs.
watch_item: Results depend on benchmark performance and learned coordination policy, so robustness to new domains, papers, and retrieval settings may require careful validation.
paper_title: Assembling the CREW: A Collaborative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Automated Related Work Generation
